name: skysynth
description: /skysynth: coding agents build a system specialized for your workload, checked by tests or machine-checked proofs. Includes the /skysynth skill, the agent roles (Spec Builder, Planner, Coding Agent, Evaluator, Critic, Auditor), and the hook that runs the tests before anything is delivered. Also install the skydiscover Python package: uv pip install git+https://github.com/skydiscover-ai/skydiscover (or run from a source checkout).
